citations.claim: EW yellow started at step 106 (E yellow) and was already all-red before NS at step 108, so yellow lasted only 2s vs required 4s
E approach shows yellow at step 106 during EW yellow phase
E approach still yellow at step 107, then red at 108

counterfactual.change: Set actuated false (fixed-time); EW yellow then runs full 4s and no violation occurs.

explanation: Actuated controller with long-waiting NS queue (N wait 61-64s, S wait 58-61s at steps 105-108) recalls NS while EW is in yellow. It preempts/aborts the EW yellow after 2s (steps 106-107 yellow, step 108 already all-red before NS) instead of letting yellow run full yellow_seconds=4. Fixed-time (actuated false) does not preempt and passes.
vision_note: The east-west approaches show green in step 105 then yellow in steps 106-107. In step 108 all signals are already red, so the yellow was cut short after only 2 seconds instead of lasting the required 4 seconds.
